evidence.note: parseSseData writes done:true with data left at the Option none default for the [DONE] sentinel, and done:false only together with O.some(decoded).
streamChatCompletion empties the stream when event.done and otherwise requires event.data; a combined done-plus-payload event is never parsed.

notes: done is projected from one SSE data line ([DONE] versus JSON). Option data is none or some, so representable is 4; supported success states are done+none and not-done+some.

evidence.note: parseSseData writes done:true and omits data for [DONE], and writes done:false only with the decoded data payload.
streamChatCompletion drops the event when done===true and otherwise decodes event.data; the combined-true case is not handled.

notes: Optional data is absent or present times done, representable 4. Supported states are the terminal marker without data and a data event with done false.
